sources.fullCitation: Jazzorchester John Morris, with vocal refrain by Erik Garell. “Ich weiß, daß du einst meinen Mund vergißt,” music by Karl Michael May and Bronisław Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter and Karl Brüll / “Du lieber Geiger, spiel einen Tango für mich,” music by Bronisław Kaper and Fritz German, words by Fritz Rotter. Discogs release 2950735; online audio reference via the YouTube upload by Brillantspecial.
